items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: A fellow by the name of McLaughrey, as I understand, owned it at that time.

ctx.x: I was born originally on First Street. And we moved from there to Valmont. We moved many times, various locations. Of course, Pine Street was the... I was actually, as a boy, I can recall my life on Calhoun, 1467 Calhoun Street, which was quite a neighborhood for young boys. We had, I guess, about 25 youngsters, all about the same age, within a radius of two city blocks there. We went to LaSalle Grammar School. I'd rather LaSalle... Yeah, the Grammar School. And then, of course, when high school came in, most of…
